summary: PHILEON Behavioral Retention — Pre-Live Hardening (Simulation Mode) verified end-to-end. Backend: pytest tests/test_retention_behavioral.py 40/40 PASS (includes 8 new pre-live hardening tests: LIVE-refused-without-sender, LIVE-active-with-dedicated-sender, global launch cap halt, prior-simulated-count-against-per-customer cap, default env keeps LIVE off, email.send_email fallback for invalid from_email, config route auth boundary, config route returns switches). Broader regression tests/ (excluding true_vine/phileon_api/adaptive_pricing_live): 982 passed / 1 pre-existing gold-spot drift failure only (test_usd_only_migration::test_dynamic_ring_migrated_to_approved_usd[annie-rose-foundation-700000]) — matches iteration_22 baseline exactly, zero regression. Curl smokes vs live preview URL: GET /api/admin/retention/config unauth → 403; with admin JWT returns switches WITHOUT leaking PHILEON_BEHAVIORAL_FROM_EMAIL address (only boolean behavioral_sender_configured=false). POST /api/behavior/newsletter/subscribe: bad email → 400, valid → 200. Frontend: /admin/retention unauth redirects to /admin/login; with admin JWT injected into localStorage.phileon_admin_token the page renders admin-retention-page with retention-live-badge='SIMULATION' (safe/gold tone), retention-config-card shows cfg-live-requested='no', cfg-sender-configured='not configured', cfg-global-cap='0 / 10'. Filter select switches queue view. Run Tick button POSTs to /api/admin/retention/tick and retention-tick-report renders with 'mode: simulated'. Preview button opens retention-preview-modal with retention-preview-html and retention-preview-close works. Newsletter footer form (/) has UNCHECKED consent checkbox by default; submit button disabled until BOTH email filled AND checkbox checked; valid submit → HTTP 200 → newsletter-ok visible. Simulation-mode invariants preserved (STRIPE_MODE=test, PHILEON_BEHAVIORAL_LIVE unset, PHILEON_BEHAVIORAL_FROM_EMAIL unset — LIVE correctly refused).

issues: Not a bug — footer NewsletterOptIn renders as designed with gold accent and unchecked-by-default consent row; wording is affirmative, no dark patterns.

critical_code_review_comments: services/retention_service.get_config() and tick() correctly enforce the LIVE-requires-behavioral-sender invariant: even with PHILEON_BEHAVIORAL_LIVE=true, if PHILEON_BEHAVIORAL_FROM_EMAIL is unset, live_effective is False and mode='simulated' — verified by test_live_mode_refused_without_behavioral_sender. Pending rows are NOT consumed as 'sent' when LIVE is refused (they remain 'pending').

Global-launch-cap logic in tick() maintains _sends_baseline snapshot + live_sent_this_tick counter and flips global_cap_hit mid-loop, so a cap=1 correctly sends 1 LIVE then defers subsequent eligible rows with reason='global_launch_cap_hit' — verified by test_global_launch_cap_halts_further_live_sends.

services/email.send_email now accepts optional from_email; invalid values silently fall back to FROM_EMAIL (validated by regex-lite 'contains @ and .-in-host'). This protects the transactional sender reputation even if a caller passes a malformed behavioral sender. Verified by test_email_send_falls_back_to_transactional_sender_when_behavioral_missing.

admin_retention.retention_config never surfaces the raw PHILEON_BEHAVIORAL_FROM_EMAIL address — only a boolean behavioral_sender_configured. Confirmed via curl (no '@' sender char in payload) and test_admin_retention_config_route_returns_switches.

NewsletterOptIn.jsx: consent state initialized to false; submit button `disabled={busy || !email || !consent}` guarantees UI cannot submit without affirmative action. No pre-checked box anywhere. Client sends { email, session_id } (no consent flag over the wire — server-side truth on the trusted POST path).

AdminRetention.jsx: badge tone/label logic correctly handles four states (LIVE ARMED · LIVE REFUSED · LIVE HALTED · SIMULATION) with contrast-appropriate colors. Preview modal uses dangerouslySetInnerHTML but preview HTML is server-built by retention_emails.build_email which is proven safe by test_email_builder_rejects_unsafe_image_urls.

Pre-existing unrelated failure: test_usd_only_migration::test_dynamic_ring_migrated_to_approved_usd[annie-rose-foundation-700000] is a gold-spot drift carry-over from prior iterations; not touched by this phase.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — newsletter opt-in form (5/5 checks: unchecked default, submit-disabled-until-both, valid-submit-200, ok-message) + admin retention panel (10/10 checks: unauth redirect, page renders, SIMULATION badge, config card fields, filter switch, run-tick, tick-report simulated, preview modal open, preview-html visible, preview-close)

All flagged with mode='simulated' — no real emails sent (PHILEON_BEHAVIORAL_LIVE=false, PHILEON_BEHAVIORAL_FROM_EMAIL unset).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Behavioral retention pre-live hardening is complete and verified. LIVE remains OFF in the preview env by design (PHILEON_BEHAVIORAL_FROM_EMAIL is intentionally unset so LIVE is refused). Do NOT set PHILEON_BEHAVIORAL_LIVE=true in the preview .env. If asked to test LIVE path, use pytest with monkeypatched env only (see test_live_mode_active_with_dedicated_sender). The only outstanding suite-wide failure remains the gold-spot drift in test_usd_only_migration (unrelated). Transactional email paths (order_emails/shipment) were NOT touched — send_email `from_email` param is optional and defaults to FROM_EMAIL.
